text:
Liza (Support): Hey team — customer tenant-42 reports ~1.5 hours of missing audit events in their SIEM export (2026-03-12 00:00–04:00 UTC window). They say the manifest shows empty batches for some 15-min windows. Can eng/security help triage? They’re requesting an ETA and whether this is a sampling/retention issue. Attaching logs below.

audit-forwarder-bot: [forwarder] tenant=tenant-42 shard=7 exported=547 events sampled=0 sampling_policy=auto start=2026-03-12T00:00Z end=2026-03-12T04:00Z
audit-forwarder-bot: [forwarder] WARNING: manifest missing for window 2026-03-12T02:00Z-02:15Z (0 bytes)

Rob (Eng): Thanks Liza — first q: is this only tenant-42 or multiple tenants? also need the S3 manifest path + object keys if possible. Does the customer have any custom sampling policy?

Liza (Support): Single-tenant report so far. Customer pasted manifest path: s3://redwood-audit-exports/prod/tenant-42/shard-7/2026-03-12/02-00.manifest.json — that file is zero bytes per their SIEM. They say other windows around it are fine. No custom sampling on their side; they rely on default auto sampling.

Maria (Ops): Noted. Quick repro I ran in staging: when event ingestion spikes and KMS decrypt latency > ~150-200ms, forwarder sometimes short-circuits sampling metadata creation and still writes a zero-byte manifest (edge case). Need to check HSM/KMS latency around that window.

Sanjay (Sec): Is there any indication of KMS errors in the forwarder logs (timeouts/403)? If keys failed we need to check for re-encrypt fallback and whether events were cached locally. Also: do we have retention/PII exposure concerns?

Liza (Support): Customer confirms no explicit 403s; they saw increased token TTLs on their side but no KMS error text. They’re worried about compliance — some of the missing events are login/role-change events.

Karen (Privacy): If role-change events are missing for >24h window we should treat this as a high-severity compliance concern. Suggest we plan a controlled replay/backfill and notify the customer about scope and timeline.

Rob (Eng): Proposed immediate actions: 1) check forwarder metrics for shard-7 around 2026-03-12T02:00Z (kms_latency, decrypt_retries, sampling_ops) 2) attempt a targeted replay for tenant-42 for 02:00–02:30 using the replay tool with increased KMS_RETRIES and fallback proxy 3) if replay fails, create a manifest backfill that points to re-encrypted objects and notify SIEM team.

Rob (Eng): Repro steps I ran (staging) — Liza please verify on prod with ops infra creds:```bash
# targeted replay
audit-replay --tenant tenant-42 --shard 7 --start 2026-03-12T02:00:00Z --end 2026-03-12T02:30:00Z --kms-retries 5 --use-key-proxy
```
Outputs/logs to check: forwarder.log, kms-proxy.log, s3 list for path above.

Maria (Ops): I pulled KMS metrics — there was a brief spike at 2026-03-12T02:03Z where decrypt latency peaked at ~320ms and one host logged a transient HSM connection reset. I’ve kicked off the replay with Rob’s flags (started at 1749998300).

Sanjay (Sec): If replay succeeds, we should capture a signed audit of the replay job and retain for 90 days in the customer’s compliance bucket. If replay fails, we need an incident playbook (notify legal/privacy + mitigation).

Liza (Support): Customer updated — they see partial backfill arriving in SIEM for 02:00–02:10. Asking for ETA on the rest.

Rob (Eng): Continuing replay; ETA ~20–30m. If any zero-byte manifests remain, I’ll run a re-encrypt fallback and update manifests to point to the re-encrypted objects.

Karen (Privacy): Thanks — please cc me on the replay audit when done.

Maria (Ops): Replay finished at 1749998580. Final status: replayed 100% of the missing events for requested window, re-encrypt fallback used for 2 objects that had HSM resets. I uploaded an incident summary to the incident tracker and added remediation: increase kms-retries default to 5 and add manifest checksum check to avoid zero-byte manifest writes. :white_check_mark:

Liza (Support): Passing to customer — they confirmed events complete in SIEM. Closing on support side pending postmortem. Assignments: Rob -> backfill/manifest-check PR, Maria -> KMS retry/monitoring alert, Sanjay/Karen -> compliance notification draft. :thumbsup:
